text: Creatures as particle-physics bodies (David's Aquarium, no Godot)
description: Vendored steam-frame-vr's procedural creatures (native/src/creatures.rs). A subset (count fader) becomes mass-spring soft bodies (swarm.rs): a particle per vertex, springs on triangle edges whose rest lengths follow the animated pose (muscles), a weak pull to the pose, a divergence-free current. Drawn as round points with world velocity into the scene G-buffer, so the net reprojects them. Next: look in the headset, tune (hold, link, flow), maybe particles that detach, trails, bodies colliding with each other or the player, fewer particles per body (subsample) for the Frame's CPU.

status.comment: Implemented and stable in a test (8 creatures = 15k particles, max 2.6 m from the pose, ~5 ms CPU per frame for 2 substeps); runs in the app (scene pass ~1 ms). Not yet looked at in the headset.
